author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.43 shipped: Night lights turn off when the room empties
summary: Night lights turn off when the room empties
why: 5.103.42 made night lights turn ON independent of the main entry action but left OFF tied to the main exit action, so a leave_on room (Living Room) kept its night light on all night; proven from recorder + activity log. First fix also dropped the sleep-protection gate to get Sleep colour, which both reviewers showed would switch main lights off in Sleep for unprotected rooms; replaced with a night-light-only helper. Master Toilet no-light was disproven as a regression (sleep-protection motion bypass=3), left for operator decision.
implications: Shipped NIGHT-LIGHT-ACTION-SELECTOR-1, LIGHT-SLEEP-ENTRYNONE-DIVERGENCE-1 at v5.103.43; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.43.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: ura_activity_log: Living Room night-light turn_off within vacancy timeout after an occupied->vacant transition at night; sleep-time night-light turn_on rows in rooms without sleep protection log mode sleep not evening; no main-light turn_off on entry during Sleep in those rooms

refs.release_notes: Night lights the rule turned on now turn off when the room empties regardless of the main exit setting (except leave-on-when-empty lights), and use Sleep colour/brightness whenever the house is in Sleep. Main-light behaviour unchanged.
